name: insights-plus-mcp-bridge
description: Connects Claude to a self-hosted UniFi Insights Plus syslog server's MCP endpoint over HTTPS, including Cloudflare Access service-token auth.
long_description:
This bundle is a local MCP server that bridges to a remote, self-hosted UniFi Insights Plus instance's `/api/mcp` endpoint. It handles the HTTP/SSE transport, the app's own bearer-token auth, and optional Cloudflare Access service-token headers (`CF-Access-Client-Id` / `CF-Access-Client-Secret`) for instances gated behind a Cloudflare Access application.

All credentials are collected through this bundle's configuration UI and stored by the host application (e.g. in the OS keychain), never written into a plaintext config file.

The upstream connection is established lazily, on the first actual tool call rather than at startup — this keeps the initial MCP handshake with the host fast and reliable even if the remote endpoint or its network path is briefly slow, and self-heals by reconnecting automatically if the upstream connection drops mid-session.

Requires a running UniFi Insights Plus instance (https://github.com/jmasarweh/UniFi-Insights-Plus) reachable over HTTPS, with its MCP feature enabled and an API bearer token generated from Settings → MCP in the app.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: API health and version info for the remote instance

tools.name: get_log
tools.description: Get a single log entry by ID

tools.name: aggregate_logs
tools.description: Aggregate logs by a chosen dimension

tools.name: export_logs_csv_url
tools.description: Get a signed URL to export filtered logs as CSV

tools.name: list_unifi_devices
tools.description: List UniFi devices known to the instance

tools.name: list_unifi_clients
tools.description: List UniFi clients known to the instance

tools.name: set_firewall_syslog
tools.description: Toggle syslog logging on a firewall policy

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List known services seen in logs

tools.name: list_protocols
tools.description: List known protocols seen in logs

tools.name: get_top_threat_ips
tools.description: Get the top threat IPs by score or count

mcp_url.title: MCP Endpoint URL
mcp_url.description: Full URL to your Insights Plus MCP endpoint, e.g. https://insights.example.com/api/mcp

bearer_token.title: MCP Bearer Token
bearer_token.description: The app's own MCP token, generated from Settings → MCP inside Insights Plus. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

cf_access_client_id.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID (optional)
cf_access_client_id.description: Only needed if the MCP endpoint sits behind a Cloudflare Access application using a Service Token policy. Looks like '<id>.access'.

cf_access_client_secret.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret (optional)
cf_access_client_secret.description: Paired with the Client ID above. Both must be set together, or neither.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the remote server to respond to a single request before failing it.

verbose_logging.title: Verbose Logging
verbose_logging.description: Log detailed connection and request diagnostics to stderr (never logs credential values).
